name: account-brief
title: Account brief
for_each: select a.account_id as id, a.account as name from v_account_position a where a.open_opps > 0 order by a.account

sections.title: The account
sections.note: Read this in the car park, not the dashboard in the meeting.
sections.sql: select a.account, a.account_type as relationship, coalesce(a.industry, '') as industry, a.territory, a.rep as owner, case when a.lifetime_won_cents > 0 then to_char(a.lifetime_won_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990') else 'nothing yet' end as lifetime_won, coalesce(to_char(a.last_activity_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'never') as last_activity from v_account_position a where a.account_id = $1

sections.title: Open opportunities
sections.sql: select p.ref, p.opportunity, p.stage, case when p.amount_cents is null then 'UNPRICED' else to_char(p.amount_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990') end as amount, to_char(p.close_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as close, coalesce(p.next_step, 'NONE') as next_step, coalesce(to_char(p.next_step_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '') as next_due from v_pipeline p where p.account_id = $1 order by p.close_date

sections.title: The people
sections.sql: select c.full_name as name, coalesce(c.title, '') as title, coalesce(c.buying_role, '') as buying_role, case when c.opted_out then 'OPTED OUT: no email, ever' else coalesce(c.email, '') end as email, coalesce(c.phone, '') as phone from contacts c where c.account_id = $1 order by c.full_name

sections.title: Recent activity
sections.sql: select to_char(x.happened_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as date, x.kind, coalesce(c.full_name, '') as with_whom, coalesce(r.full_name, '') as rep, x.note from activities x left join contacts c on c.id = x.contact_id left join reps r on r.id = x.rep_id where x.account_id = $1 order by x.happened_on desc limit 10

name: rep-forecast
title: Forecast one-pager
for_each: select f.rep_id as id, (f.rep || ' ' || f.period) as name from v_forecast f order by f.rep

sections.title: The quarter
sections.sql: select f.rep, f.period, to_char(f.quota_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990') as quota, to_char(f.closed_won_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990') as closed_won, to_char(f.weighted_quarter_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990') as weighted_this_quarter, case when f.quota_cents - f.closed_won_cents - f.weighted_quarter_cents > 0 then to_char((f.quota_cents - f.closed_won_cents - f.weighted_quarter_cents) / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990') else 'covered' end as gap, f.days_left_in_quarter || ' days' as left_in_quarter from v_forecast f where f.rep_id = $1

sections.title: Deals committed to this quarter
sections.note: Open deals with a close date inside the quarter. Every one needs a dated next step.
sections.sql: select p.ref, p.account, p.opportunity, p.stage, case when p.amount_cents is null then 'UNPRICED' else to_char(p.amount_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990') end as amount, p.probability || '%' as probability, to_char(p.close_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as close, coalesce(p.next_step, 'NONE') as next_step from v_pipeline p join reps r on r.full_name = p.rep where r.id = $1 and p.close_date < (date_trunc('quarter', current_date) + interval '3 months')::date order by p.close_date

sections.title: The rest of the pipeline
sections.sql: select p.ref, p.account, p.opportunity, p.stage, case when p.amount_cents is null then 'UNPRICED' else to_char(p.amount_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990') end as amount, to_char(p.close_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as close from v_pipeline p join reps r on r.full_name = p.rep where r.id = $1 and p.close_date >= (date_trunc('quarter', current_date) + interval '3 months')::date order by p.close_date

name: win-loss-review
title: Win and loss review, last 90 days
for_each: select gen_random_uuid() as id, 'win-loss last 90 days' as name

sections.title: Won
sections.sql: select o.ref, a.name as account, o.name as opportunity, to_char(o.amount_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990') as amount, to_char(o.won_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as won, coalesce(r.full_name, '') as rep, (o.won_on - o.opened_on) || ' days' as cycle from opportunities o join accounts a on a.id = o.account_id left join reps r on r.id = o.rep_id where o.won_on >= current_date - 90 and $1::uuid is not null order by o.won_on desc

sections.title: Lost, with the reasons written down
sections.note: The reasons are required at the gate, so this table is never empty excuses.
sections.sql: select o.ref, a.name as account, o.name as opportunity, to_char(o.amount_cents / 100.0, 'FM$999,999,990') as amount, to_char(o.lost_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as lost, coalesce(r.full_name, '') as rep, coalesce(o.lost_reason, '') as reason from opportunities o join accounts a on a.id = o.account_id left join reps r on r.id = o.rep_id where o.lost_on >= current_date - 90 and $1::uuid is not null order by o.lost_on desc
